end.summary:
- Practised sorting wet waste for the green bin and dry waste for the blue bin.
- Identified peels, leaves and dal as wet waste; a broken toy and newspaper as dry waste.
- Explained that peels and leaves can rot into compost, while plastic remains unchanged.
- Discussed reporting a dripping tap to the teacher so it can be repaired.
- Teach-back was not passed; saving water and keeping the school safe and green remained incomplete.
end.parentNote: Anika practised waste sorting, composting, and reporting a leaking tap. They first mixed up plastic with compostable waste, then corrected this later by explaining that only peels and leaves should go into compost and plastic does not rot. At home, ask Anika to sort a few household items into wet and dry waste and name one way to save water.
